news.title: UI builds on tradition as nation’s top public university for writing
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa remains the nation’s top public university for writing in the latest U.S. News & World Report Best Colleges rankings. Ranked No. 10 overall in writing in the disciplines, Iowa has been recognized as the best public university for six consecutive years.

news.title: Jupiter uses surprisingly complex system to fend off particles from sun
news.summary_en: University of Iowa researchers have made the most detailed observations yet of Jupiter’s bow shock, a barrier that helps deflect harmful particles from the sun. They found that Jupiter uses a more complex wave structure than Earth to efficiently handle the solar wind. The findings could help scientists understand the physics associated with powerful energy released by dying stars.
